question: Where is the exact jointly feasible boundary between the failed rank45 and passing rank55 source graphs?
construction: For N in 46..54, allow the union of the frozen donor top20 and the first N components of the frozen deletion ranking. Evaluate unchanged coordinate, behavior, and control gates under both fits.
selection_rule: Select the smallest jointly feasible N. No membership, order, or threshold is adapted.

predictions.pred_a_authority_self_clamp_finiteness_a: authorities replay, self-clamp is exact, values are finite, and <=71 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_boundary_contains_a_feasible_pref: at least one rank46..54 arm is jointly feasible
predictions.pred_c_feasibility_is_monotone_above_bou: every tested prefix at or above the selected N is jointly feasible
predictions.pred_e_selected_arm_is_crossfit_stable: selected minimum-coordinate projections differ by <=0.05 and per-task behavior projections differ by <=0.05 across fits

decision: Promote the smallest passing prefix as the frozen circuit support and next apply backward deletion/grouped interaction audits within it.
